⚖️ Know Your Rights. Know the Law.
Law is not meant to be understood only inside a courtroom.
Awareness of our basic constitutional rights helps us understand when to speak up, when to seek legal assistance, and how to protect ourselves through lawful means.
From Right to Equality and Right to Freedom to Right to Life, Constitutional Remedies and Legal Aid — knowing the basics is the first step towards becoming a legally aware citizen.
5 Constitutional Rights Every Citizen Should Know the Law Understand Your Rights Stay
Informed.
"Legal awareness is not just knowledge of law - it is the confidence to understand and exercise your rights responsibly."
- Adv. Preeti Singh Yadav
Patna High Court

comment: Legal awareness becomes meaningful when citizens know the practical route to enforce rights—access to legal aid, timely advice, and proper documentation often decide outcomes.
